create.name: Lissa Edmond
create.bio:
Lissa Edmond is an insight meditation practitioner and somatic facilitator who also works as a psychiatric nurse practitioner; this listing covers only the contemplative side of their work, offered through Embodied Heart Mind. Their own practice of dharma, meditation and mindful movement began in 2008, and they have spent more than a year in all on silent retreat. Their main path draws on Vipassana as taught in the lines of Mahasi Sayadaw and Sayadaw U Tejaniya, samadhi practice from the Pa Auk tradition, and the brahmaviharas, the four boundless qualities of the heart. Since 2025 they have been training as a retreat teacher with Insight Meditation Society and Spirit Rock.

Lissa has led sangha gatherings since 2016 and has helped on insight retreats since 2019, guiding mindful movement and body awareness, including online groups for BIPOC and queer practitioners. They meet students one to one for dharma mentoring on a dana basis, kept apart from any clinical work, and run an online library of more than two hundred recorded practices: guided sitting, dharma reflections, gentle yoga, qigong flows and reflective journaling. Their teaching is trauma-sensitive and inclusive, and it returns again and again to kindness, care and listening to the body.

courses.title: Mindfulness and Dharma Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring meetings rooted in insight meditation, offering guidance for formal sitting practice and for bringing the dharma into daily life. Held outside any clinical setting and offered for dana, so students give what they can.

courses.title: Embodied Practices Video Library
courses.description: An online collection of more than two hundred recorded practices: guided meditation and dharma reflections, gentle and chair yoga, qigong flows and reflective journaling. Practices can be rented for a day on a give-what-you-can basis, or opened in full with a monthly membership.

courses.title: Mindfulness & Stress Resourcing 6-Week Series
courses.description: A recorded six-week series introducing mindfulness practice alongside an understanding of how the body responds to stress, with simple ways to meet stress and worry with care. It grew out of Lissa's doctoral project.

free_resources.title: Integrating Mindful Movement and Embodied Practice in Daily Life
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide from Lissa's site with ideas for weaving mindful movement and body awareness into ordinary days.
